description: Operational validation policy for real read-only IBKR stock mark refresh before paper-only daemon execution.
required_behavior: Attempt mark_refresh.mode=ibkr by default; do not use copy_existing for the primary validation path.
Use read-only reqMktData stock marks only and never submit, stage, preview, or transmit broker orders.
If IBKR refresh succeeds with complete live marks, record mark-refresh pass and run normal paper sizing.
If IBKR refresh fails or partially misses but fallback is fresh enough, record mark-refresh warn and apply M140 quality size reduction.
If both IBKR refresh and fallback quality fail, block scheduler execution through skipped_mark_refresh_gate.
Keep M137 preflight after refresh/fallback so stale, delayed, or missing marks remain independently blocked.

expected_outcomes.condition: IBKR connected and live stock data available
IBKR unavailable but fallback source is fresh
IBKR unavailable and fallback source stale or missing
